description: Find individual products currently on sale by keyword, optionally with a maximum price, currency and country. Returns up to 10 products with sale price, regular price, ship-to countries and links, and says when there are more. Covers products on sale, not coupon codes.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. CH or US. Returns offers for that country plus worldwide ones.

currency.description: ISO currency, e.g. USD, EUR, CHF

name: search_products
title: Search products on sale
